description: Self-contained stress suite for evaluating diff-mode prompting and diff-apply robustness on hard editing scenarios.

cases.description: String quote escaping and literal replacement.
cases.change_request: Rename the string literal from A to AX while keeping Verilog syntax valid.

cases.description: Add reset input and reset branch to existing always_ff block.
cases.change_request: Add input rst and make reset synchronous active-high so q is set to 1'b0 when rst is asserted.

cases.description: Change one of two similar always_ff blocks while preserving the other.
cases.change_request: Only in TARGET_BLOCK, change y <= a; to y <= ~a;. KEEP_BLOCK must remain unchanged.

cases.description: Minimal anchor edit from AND to XOR.
cases.change_request: Change the combinational logic from AND to XOR with minimal unique anchors.
Append localparam int WIDTH = 8; inside the module body.

cases.description: Long file edit requiring precise anchor selection.
cases.change_request: Change the increment step from +1 to +2 while preserving all other lines.

cases.description: RTLLM-style asynchronous FIFO parameter scaling edit.
cases.change_request: Scale FIFO depth from 16 to 32 and update ADDR_W accordingly.
Toggle clk_out when cnt is 0 or DIV>>1 to improve duty-cycle behavior.
When opn_valid is high, latch signed_mode from op_signed instead of forcing 0.
Add explicit NOP decode for opcode 4'h0 that keeps state at IDLE.

cases.description: Intentionally ambiguous anchor scenario to reward safe rejection behavior.
cases.change_request: Change exactly one occurrence of `a & b` to `a | b` while using the smallest possible search anchor.
Update the assign expression to OR while preserving module structure.
